2026-09-23 direction. Continue authorized work through substantive outcomes;
checkpoints and root reviews are progress updates. A new task resets no allowance.

context; retrieve it only for a concrete question.

[C8 result](../evidence/native-replacement-validation-2026-09-21/n1-f1-c8-result.md)
passed in 17.514 seconds. One boot/readiness, three distinct snapshots and one
shutdown succeeded. Preboot/postboot/cleanup captured 788/904/784 complete host
rows in 0.299/0.103/0.045 seconds. No failure or stabilization transition occurred.

proof. All three retained targets ended Shutdown, with no matching processes and
idle ports. Fresh memory pressure was normal; 27.577 GiB was free at/after boot.

This is collector diagnostic evidence only, not application acceptance or proof
that either prior failure is fixed. C6's delayed query and C7's unavailable path
did not reproduce. No Settings/Maestro/TableUs operation or live provider ran.

`6f3b1ba1c9bf7a788293877cf85334c030f6ac8a8bc0a7ee2a874b364a4cf26c`.

and runtime evidence remain separate; see the result for paths and receipt hashes.

Settings-baseline and conditional offline/refresh campaign. Preserve original
acceptance criteria, aggregate/attempt/disk limits, root visual review and
first-failure closure; then request one approval for the exact complete scope.

inside an approved campaign are progress, not separate approval checkpoints.

The [approved proposal](n1-f1-c8-proposal.md) completed in **17.514 seconds** on
2026-09-25 at 05:35:16 UTC. One boot, one boot-readiness command, three distinct
host snapshots and one shutdown succeeded. Root reviewed the raw evidence and
confirmed cleanup. C8 is closed with zero remaining native attempts.

configured and aggregate deadlines. The outer launcher completed in 17.628 seconds.

cleanup snapshot has no matching processes and the operator recorded idle ports.
The review used retained evidence only and issued no additional native queries.
Luna independently extracted the same result for root review.

This establishes that the instrumented collector worked for **this one postboot

context or stabilization path was exercised. It does not establish a general
reliability fix or application acceptance. No Settings, Maestro, TableUs operation,

campaign using the current collector, with exact frozen inputs and original
first-failure, attempt, disk and aggregate limits. Present that complete prepared
scope for approval before any further native run. C8 unused time creates no retry.

Android/N2 and release gates remain unchanged.
